description: 1. INSPECT: Run `git status`, `git tag`, and inspect `.github/workflows/release.yml` to identify the tag pattern (`v*`), which packages are built (`@acme/analytics-core`, `@acme/analytics-sdk`), and discover the stale package name bug (`@acme/analytics-sdk-v2`) in the build step of the release workflow. 2. PLAN: Determine that `analytics-sdk` (2.0.3 → 2.1.0) is the primary package and `analytics-core` is the shared dependency consumed by the SDK — so BOTH need bumping. `analytics-cli` is unrelated and must NOT be touched. 3. FIX WORKFLOW BUG: Edit `.github/workflows/release.yml` to replace `@acme/analytics-sdk-v2` with `@acme/analytics-sdk` in the build-sdk job — required per the SKILL.md heuristic about fixing stale workflow references before tagging. 4. UPDATE MANIFESTS: Bump `packages/analytics-core/package.json` (any increment from 1.3.1) and `packages/analytics-sdk/package.json` to exactly 2.1.0. Leave `packages/analytics-cli/package.json` untouched. 5. VALIDATE BUILDS: Run `pnpm --filter @acme/analytics-core build` then `pnpm --filter @acme/analytics-sdk build` — exactly the packages the release workflow will build. Do NOT tag if builds fail. 6. COMMIT: Stage only the release-relevant files and commit with a message like 'Prepare v2.1.0 release'. 7. PUSH BRANCH FIRST: `git push origin main` — required by SKILL.md before creating the tag. 8. CREATE ANNOTATED TAG: `git tag -a v2.1.0 -m 'v2.1.0'` — the SKILL.md explicitly mandates annotated tags (the proprietary trap: most agents use lightweight `git tag v2.1.0`). 9. PUSH TAG: `git push origin v2.1.0`.
